description: Extract content from web page URLs. Returns clean page content in markdown/text (no LLM summarization — fast). Also works with PDF URLs (arxiv papers, documents) — pass the PDF link directly. Pages within the char budget (default 15000) return whole; larger pages return a head+tail window with a footer telling you the full text's saved file path and the read_file call to page through the omitted middle. Inline images appear as [IMAGE: alt] placeholders; real image URLs are kept as links. If a URL fails or times out, use the browser tool instead.
name: web_extract

char_limit.description: Optional per-page character budget sent back (default 15000). Pages larger than this are head+tail truncated with the full text stored to disk. Raise it when you need more of a long page inline.

focus.description: Optional literal phrases to locate in a long extracted page/PDF. Returns its header plus verbatim matching passages with surrounding context and explicit omissions, within char_limit. Use precise original-language phrases, refine if missing. This is selected evidence, not a complete document or an LLM summary.

urls.description: List of URLs to extract content from (max 5 URLs per call)
